title: Credit Controller
description:
REED Accountancy and Finance are working in partnership with a leading Poole Based Manufacturing and Warehouse Firm recruiting a Permanent Credit Controller to join a busy and dynamic Finance Team.

CREDIT CONTROL POSITION
- Contract type: Permanent
- Salary - up to £30,000 per annum
- Hours: 40 hours per week
- Monday-Friday 8am-5pm

Details

Effectively manage and control debts. Responsible for collecting invoices and ensure that credit given to customers is monitored whilst providing excellent customer service.

What you will be doing

Act as a main point of contact for customer account queries
- Reconciliation, managing customer portals and integration (EDI)
- Review new and existing accounts for creditworthiness, setting or suggesting appropriate terms and credit limits, considering previous history, credit agency and trade references and other relevant sources of information

- Resolve invoice and payment queries promptly and efficiently
- Produce and distribute customer statements of account.
- Produce and distribute customer overdue/reminder letters
- Produce and circulate weekly and ad hoc on stop, credit hold status and other reports.
- Proactive management of new accounts and high value invoices
- Build effective relationships with customers and internal contacts.
- Prepare month end consolidated invoices.
- Escalate significant issues/concerns as necessary

title: JUNIOR FINANCE ADMINISTRATOR
company: Talent Sure Recruitment Limited - Agency - Contract
description:
Junior Finance Administrator

Location: Bournemouth

Salary: £25,000 per annum (increasing after probation)

Hours: Monday-Friday 8:30am 5:30pm

Contract: Temporary to Permanent

About the Opportunity

We are recruiting on behalf of a busy, fast-growing service provider based in central Bournemouth. Well-known for their great workplace culture, and genuine commitment to staff wellbeing, they are looking for an enthusiastic Junior Finance Administrator to join their team.

Reporting directly to the Finance Manager, you will play a hands-on role in supporting daily financial operations, statement reconciliations, and sales ledger processing.

If you bring a sharp eye for detail, strong communication skills, and a positive, practical attitude, this role offers an ideal step to kickstart or build your career in corporate finance.

Key Responsibilities
- Supplier Invoice Processing - Log incoming supplier invoices received via post and email, checking details accurately against operational records.
- Discrepancy Resolution - Spot and investigate billing errors between invoices and internal data, clearing up issues quickly with internal teams.
- Purchase Order Administration - Process purchase orders and additional costs in the internal system to keep client billing accurate.
- Supplier Statement Reconciliation - Reconcile supplier accounts, work out payment runs, spot mistakes, and contact suppliers directly about missing paperwork.
- Data Entry & System Updates - Input accurate invoice data into core Sage accounting software, keeping records clear and up to date.
- General Office Administration - Handle daily administrative duties, digital filing, and secure paperwork disposal.

What We Are Looking For

We are seeking a positive, clear thinking individual who works well in a fast-paced environment and enjoys getting the details right.

Key Qualifications & Attributes:
- Relevant Experience - Prior experience in a finance, data-entry, or general office administration role.
- Numeracy & Accuracy - Strong attention to detail with a natural comfort working with numbers and figures.
- Communication Skills - A clear, friendly approach when speaking with suppliers and colleagues.
- Organisational Ability - Good time-management skills with the ability to handle daily paperwork and keep on top of tasks.
- Software Literacy - Confident using Microsoft Office. (Knowledge of Sage or FileMaker is a bonus, but full training on their systems will be given).

What the Business Offers
- Comprehensive Onboarding - Full training on internal processes and software management systems.
- Workplace Culture - Join a friendly, supportive team within a well-regarded commercial organisation.
- Career Stability - Long-term career security with ongoing opportunities to develop your operational skills.

How to Apply

If you have a solid administrative foundation and want to grow your career in finance, please send over your CV today for immediate consideration.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Are you an experienced payroll professional who enjoys working closely with clients and taking ownership of your work?

We're looking for a Payroll Administrator to join a friendly and collaborative payroll team, delivering accurate, reliable and responsive payroll services to a diverse portfolio of businesses.

This is a client-facing role where you'll have the opportunity to build strong relationships, manage your own portfolio and play an important part in ensuring payrolls are processed accurately and on time.

The Role

As a Payroll Administrator, you'll take responsibility for a portfolio of clients, working closely with them to deliver a high-quality payroll service while supporting the wider team.

What you'll be doing
- Processing a variety of client payrolls as part of a collaborative payroll team
- Acting as the primary point of contact for an allocated portfolio of clients
- Managing client payrolls from start to finish, ensuring accuracy and compliance
- Supporting the onboarding of new clients and payrolls, ensuring data is complete and accurate
- Identifying opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency and enhance the client experience
- Building and maintaining strong, professional client relationships
- Responding to payroll queries accurately, professionally and within agreed timescales
- Keeping up to date with changes in payroll legislation and ensuring these are correctly applied
- Liaising with HMRC regarding employer payments and payroll-related matters
- Ensuring payroll deadlines are consistently met
- Working collaboratively with colleagues and providing support where required

About You

You'll be an organised and detail-focused payroll professional who takes pride in delivering an accurate and dependable service.

You'll ideally have:
- Strong knowledge and practical experience of UK payroll legislation
- Experience managing a portfolio of clients or multiple payrolls
- A proven track record of delivering excellent client service
- Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to your work
- Confident written and verbal communication skills
- The ability to build positive working relationships with a wide range of clients
- The ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a wider team
- Excellent organisation and time-management skills, with the ability to work to strict deadlines
- Good numerical and analytical skills
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook
- A professional, courteous and solutions-focused approach

What's on Offer?

You'll join an organisation that values its people and provides a supportive environment in which to develop your career.

Alongside a competitive salary, you'll have access to a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing.

Financial wellbeing
- Employer-supported pension scheme
- Group life assurance
- Income protection
- Health cash plan, including support for eligible dependants

Mental wellbeing
- Confidential counselling and emotional support
- Virtual GP and second-opinion services
- Access to trained Mental Health First Aiders
- A range of resources to support your overall wellbeing

Physical wellbeing
- Cycle to work scheme
- Access to discounted gym, pool and fitness memberships
- Digital health and wellbeing resources
- Support and resources around menopause and women's health

Additional benefits
- Family-friendly benefits and enhanced family leave
- The opportunity to purchase additional annual leave
- Paid volunteering day each year
- Electric vehicle lease scheme, subject to eligibility
- Recognition of key career and family milestones
- Regular expert-led wellbeing webinars
- Access to charitable support for colleagues experiencing financial hardship

Why Join?

This is an excellent opportunity to join an established and forward-thinking professional services organisation where people are encouraged to develop, collaborate and make a genuine contribution.

You'll work alongside experienced payroll professionals, supporting a varied client base and gaining exposure to a broad range of payroll requirements.

The organisation offers a flexible approach to hybrid working, alongside a strong focus on learning, development, wellbeing and creating an inclusive working environment where people can be themselves.

If you're an experienced payroll professional looking for a role where client relationships, technical expertise and quality service are equally important, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more.
